items.title: 66095_Benny Carter oral history interview
items.q: With Tyree Glenn joining the band during the time that we were at the Savoy

ctx.x: It could very well have been, or the band that I took in to the Savoy probably contained some of the same members.
Uh huh. For example, you had in the Savoy, I think that was the group with Tyree Glenn?
Oh yes. With Tyree Glenn joining the band during the time that we were at the Savoy, so he wouldn't have been with us before that.
